spec.label: R-I072-1
spec.notes: Symptoms: at the parent 40c0094, check_pick_entered returns as soon as today's marker status is 'confirmed' or 'alerted' (exit 0, no account query). (1) TestCheckPickEntered::test_marker_dedupes_second_alert: the first run (18:30 ET, 40 min to the 19:10 pitch, no entry) DMs, writes 'alerted' and exits 1; the second run at 18:32 returns on the 'alerted' marker with exit 0, so line 1242 fails: the 7/08 shape (one alert, then no re-verification). (2) TestCheckPickEnteredEscalation::test_alerted_reverifies_and_confirms_when_entry_appears: the marker is 'alerted' and the entry is now present; the parent returns without querying (exit 0, line 1374 passes) and the marker stays 'alerted', so line 1375 fails. Static checks: the helpers patch only names present at 40c0094; _save_pick's DailyPick notification fields exist there and is_scoreable_commit's pick_was_delivered fallback admits the delivered pick; the parent's window is 5 <= m <= 75 (18:30 and 18:32 ET are 40 and 38 min to pitch); module imports exist at the parent. Anchors at e5ef7ca: 'assert r2.exit_code != 0  # still unentered' is unique (line 1242); the confirmed assertion occurs at 1375 and 1511, and 1375 is inside the symptom test. Other selected nodes at the parent: test_alerted_before_thresholds_reverifies_without_dm, test_t30_escalation_fires_once, test_t15_escalation_after_t30, test_escalation_dm_failure_retries_next_run, test_legacy_marker_without_escalations_treated_as_initial, test_unverified_presence_is_nonterminal, test_missing_slot_count_is_mismatch_despite_crosswalk_gap and test_exactly_five_minutes_is_outside_window fail by assertion (escalation tiers, the present_unverified escape (I-110) and the cutoff boundary: not declared); test_initial_near_cutoff_consumes_lower_tiers fails with KeyError ('escalations' is absent from the parent's marker); test_unverified_then_match_confirms passes. tests/health/test_pick_entry_source.py is deliberately not selected (module-level import of the new bts.health.pick_entry). Lead's review: dropped test_initial_near_cutoff_consumes_lower_tiers from the selection: each fails at the parent only because of a name, field or keyword the fix added (new API), never by assertion, and adds nothing to the replay.
